# NES.css Design System

> A retro 8-bit React design system built on NES.css: chunky pixel borders, the Press Start 2P font, hard shadows, two palettes (retro and fresh), 20 typed components, 215 pixel rune icons and a pixel icon studio. Static site; all pages are prerendered HTML.

Setup: import the library stylesheet `styles/nes.css` once at the app root, then import components (e.g. `NesButton`, `NesContainer`) from the library barrel. Visual variation is expressed only through props (`variant`, `size`, `state`, `dark`, `rounded`). Switch palettes with `data-nes-theme="fresh"` on `<html>`.

Full component reference with props: https://design.2.MikeDemo.dev/llms-full.txt

## Pages

- [Overview](https://design.2.MikeDemo.dev/): What the system is and how to set it up
- [Components](https://design.2.MikeDemo.dev/components): Live examples of every component
- [Component specs](https://design.2.MikeDemo.dev/specs): Anatomy, spacing, colors, typography, states and props per component
- [Colors](https://design.2.MikeDemo.dev/colors): Both palettes and their tokens
- [Typography](https://design.2.MikeDemo.dev/typography): Type scale and font stack
- [Icons](https://design.2.MikeDemo.dev/icons): NES icons, pixel sprites, rune icons and custom icons
- [Accessibility](https://design.2.MikeDemo.dev/accessibility): Contrast numbers, rules and fallbacks
- [Icon studio](https://design.2.MikeDemo.dev/studio): Draw custom 16x16 pixel icons
